reuse.why: Consolidates the five link bodies into linkBankSyncAccount, the org-keyed providers into one factory and the three identical downloads into downloadOrgBankSyncTransactions, so Fintegra is added as one-line configurations; the takeover reuses a clearAccountLink that unlinkAccount now also calls.

duplication.why: Removes the copied link, download and unlink-field blocks rather than adding another copy; the per-provider account-id extractors at registration are trivial.

placement.why: The link rules (closed check, already-linked check, local unlink) live as documented functions in accounts/link.ts and download logic stays in sync.ts; enforcing the rules through a registration-time decorator keeps them outside the link flow itself.

scope.why: Everything serves the four requests, but it also refactors the provider download functions beyond what was asked, generalises cloudFileId to every provider, and adds an unused SyncServerFintegraAccount type.

maintainability.why: Adding or changing a provider or a link rule is now a single edit with explicit variation (sync tables, bank key, extra headers); the factory/decorator indirection is slightly harder to trace than plain functions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers go through guardBankAccountLink and linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount now uses clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Duplicated logic was removed and shared, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink (returning the holder id for the guard to clear after linking); the closed-account rule is a separate function rather than a branch; no caller bypasses the guard.
